title: Annotatio V §.IV: Consenters in all Fundamentals (Annot. 2) constitute one and the same Christian Church
pass_a_gloss: Whence further, as in the superior Annotation 2 we rightly and deservedly called those consenting in the faith, and those alone, who agree in all Fundamentals, though they dissent in others; so in this place we maintain that all those constitute one and the same Christian Church who hold the same Fundamentals.
pass_b_english: So, as in Annotation 2 above we rightly called consenters in the faith only those who agree in all Fundamentals, though they differ elsewhere,
here we hold that all who keep the same Fundamentals make up one and the same Christian Church.
source_text: Unde porrò, uti jure meritoque Annot. superior. 2da consentientes in fide illos diximus, illosque solos, qui in Fundamentalibus omnibus consentiunt, in aliis licèt dissentiant; ita hôc locô omnes istos unam eandemque Ecclesiam Christianam constituere perhibemus, qui eadem Fundamentalia tenent.
